function diffStore(tag: string, idx: number, st: TileStore): Row {
  const c = chans(idx);
  const r: Row = { idx, tag, dA: 0, dT: 0, dW: 0, dL: 0, dHf: 0, dSl: 0, dLt: 0, dIa: 0, first: '', pairs: [], samples: [] };
  const pair = new Map<string, number>();
  let firstI = -1;
  const mark = (i: number) => { if (firstI < 0) firstI = i; };
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const va = c.a[i]!, ja = st.flags[i]! & 1;
    if (va !== ja) { r.dA++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`A(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${va} j${ja}`); }
    const vt = va ? c.t[i]! : 0;
    const jt = ja ? (SHEET[st.type[i]!] >= 0 ? SHEET[st.type[i]!]! : 9999) : 0;
    if (vt !== jt) { r.dT++; mark(i); const k = `T${vt}>${jt}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`T(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${vt} j${jt}`); }
    if (c.w[i]! !== st.wall[i]!) { r.dW++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`W(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.w[i]} j${st.wall[i]}`); }
    if (c.l[i]! !== st.liquid[i]!) { r.dL++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`L(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.l[i]} j${st.liquid[i]}`); }
    if (c.hf[i]! !== st.half[i]!) { r.dHf++; mark(i); const k = `H${c.hf[i]}>${st.half[i]}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`H(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.hf[i]} j${st.half[i]}`); }
    if (c.sl[i]! !== st.slope[i]!) { r.dSl++; mark(i); const k = `S${c.sl[i]}>${st.slope[i]}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`S(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${c.sl[i]} j${st.slope[i]}`); }
    const vl = c.l[i]! > 0 ? c.lt[i]! + 1 : 0;
    const jl = st.liquid[i]! > 0 ? st.liquidType[i]! : 0;
    if (vl !== jl) { r.dLt++; mark(i); const k = `Y${vl}>${jl}`; pair.set(k, (pair.get(k) ?? 0) + 1); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`Y(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${vl} j${jl} liq${c.l[i]}`); }
    const via = c.ia[i]! ? 1 : 0;
    const jia = (st.wire[i]! >>> 5) & 1;
    if (via !== jia) { r.dIa++; mark(i); if (r.samples.length < 10) r.samples.push(`I(${i % W},${(i / W) | 0}) v${via} j${jia}`); }
  }
  if (firstI >= 0) r.first = `(${firstI % W},${Math.floor(firstI / W)})`;
  r.pairs = [...pair.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1]).slice(0, 8).map(([k, n]) => [k, n] as [string, number]);
  return r;
}
const isClean = (r: Row) => !(r.dA || r.dT || r.dW || r.dL || r.dHf || r.dSl || r.dLt || r.dIa);
function printRow(r: Row): void {
  const bad = !isClean(r);
  console.log(`${String(r.idx).padStart(3)} ${DUMPNAME.get(r.idx)} ← ${r.tag.padEnd(28)} ` +
    `A=${String(r.dA).padStart(6)} T=${String(r.dT).padStart(6)} W=${String(r.dW).padStart(5)} L=${String(r.dL).padStart(5)} ` +
    `Hf=${String(r.dHf).padStart(5)} Sl=${String(r.dSl).padStart(5)} Lt=${String(r.dLt).padStart(4)} Ia=${String(r.dIa).padStart(4)} ${bad ? '✗ ' + r.first : '✓'}`);
  if (bad) {
    console.log(`     pairs: ${r.pairs.map(([k, n]) => `${k}×${n}`).join(' ')}`);
    console.log(`     samples: ${r.samples.join(' | ')}`);
  }
}

// ---- 槽位计划 ----
type Chests = Array<{ x: number; y: number; items: Array<{ id: number; stack: number } | null> }>;
interface Step {
  dump?: number;                       // 对拍 golden 槽
  base: number;                        // 输入基座 golden 槽
  run: (st: TileStore, gs: GenState, rng: RNG, chests: Chests, world: World) => void | Promise<void>;
}
interface SlotPlan { entry: string; steps: Step[] }

/** 跨槽生产者重算：shrineSpots / oceanTreasures（golden47/36 干净基座 + m_ 中途边界） */
function computeProducers(): { shrineSpots: Array<{ x: number; y: number }>; oceanTreasures: Array<{ x: number; y: number }> } {
  const mj = boundary('m_JungleShrines');
  const { st: stJ } = buildHybrid(47, mj);
  restoreGenSolid(mj.gensolid);
  const shrineSpots = runJungleShrinePass(stJ, new RNG(SEED), structuredClone(mj.gs) as GenState);
  const mo = boundary('m_OceanCaves');
  const { st: stO } = buildHybrid(36, mo);
  restoreGenSolid(mo.gensolid);
  const oceanTreasures = runOceanCavesPass(stO, new RNG(SEED), structuredClone(mo.gs) as GenState);
  return { shrineSpots, oceanTreasures };
}

async function runSettleStep(st: TileStore, gs: GenState, rng: RNG, world: World): Promise<void> {
  world.store = st;
  world.shimmerX = gs.shimmerX; world.shimmerY = gs.shimmerY;
  world.genWaterLine = gs.waterLine;
  if ((gs.dungeonSide as number) === 0) world.genDungeonExempt = null;
  else {
    const edge = Math.floor(world.w * 0.05), mid = Math.floor(world.w * 0.55);
    world.genDungeonExempt = gs.dungeonSide < 0
      ? { x0: edge, x1: Math.floor(world.w * 0.45), y0: Math.floor(gs.worldSurface) + 10, y1: (world.h - 200) - 10 }
      : { x0: mid, x1: world.w - edge, y0: Math.floor(gs.worldSurface) + 10, y1: (world.h - 200) - 10 };
  }
  await settleWorldLiquids(world, 'gen', undefined, rng);
  flipGenSolid([484], false);
}

// jsSlot → golden 槽步进表（JS 槽界 = s{jsSlot-1}；entry 槽的 gs/GenSolid 快照起）

(RUN ? it : it.skip)(`WWW tail replay ${FROM}..${TO}`, async () => {
  const t0 = Date.now();
  const producersBox: { shrineSpots: Array<{ x: number; y: number }> | null; oceanTreasures: Array<{ x: number; y: number }> | null } = { shrineSpots: null, oceanTreasures: null };
  const plans = makePlans(producersBox);
  const world = new World(W, H, SEED);
  const rows: Row[] = [];

  const slots = [...plans.keys()].filter(s => {
    const ds = plans.get(s)!.steps.map(x => x.dump ?? 999).filter(d => d < 999);
    return ds.some(d => d >= FROM && d <= TO);
  }).sort((a, b) => a - b);
  for (const s of slots) {
    const plan = plans.get(s)!;
    if (plan.steps.some(x => x.dump === 61 || x.dump === 62) && !producersBox.shrineSpots) {
      const producers = computeProducers();
      producersBox.shrineSpots = producers.shrineSpots; producersBox.oceanTreasures = producers.oceanTreasures;
      console.log(`producers: shrineSpots=${producersBox.shrineSpots.length} oceanTreasures=${producersBox.oceanTreasures.length}`);
    }
    const entry = boundary(plan.entry);
    const gs: GenState = structuredClone(entry.gs);
    restoreGenSolid(entry.gensolid);
    __setGenStateForProbe(gs);
    const chests = structuredClone(entry.chests) as Chests;
    let prev: PrevOut | null = null;
    for (const step of plan.steps) {
      const built = prev ? buildHybrid(step.base, prev) : buildHybrid(step.base, entry);
      if (built.revMiss) console.log(`  [revMiss] base=${step.base} cells=${built.revMiss}`);
      const rng = new RNG(SEED);
      await step.run(built.st, gs, rng, chests, world);
      if (step.dump !== undefined && step.dump >= FROM && step.dump <= TO) {
        rows.push(diffStore(`jsSlot${s}`, step.dump, built.st));
      }
      prev = prevOf(built.st);
    }
    __setGenStateForProbe(null);
  }
  for (const r of rows) printRow(r);
  const bad = rows.filter(r => !isClean(r));
  console.log(`\n★ 尾段裁决 ${FROM}..${TO}: ${rows.length} 槽对拍，自因差槽 ${bad.length} 个`);
  for (const r of bad) console.log(`  ✗ #${r.idx} ${DUMPNAME.get(r.idx)} first=${r.first} pairs=${r.pairs.slice(0, 4).map(([k, n]) => `${k}×${n}`).join(' ')}`);
  console.log(`done ${((Date.now() - t0) / 1000).toFixed(0)}s`);
}, 560_000);

6	namespace Terraria.WorldBuilding
7	{
8	    public static class SlopeProbe
9	    {
10	        public static bool _on;
11	        static StreamWriter _w;
12	        static FieldInfo _sa, _ix;
13	        static string P() { var p = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SW_SLOPEP"); return string.IsNullOrEmpty(p) ? "/tmp/oooo-slope.txt" : p; }
14	        public static void RP(string passName)
15	        {
16	            if (passName == "Piles")
17	            {
18	                _on = true;
19	                _w = new StreamWriter(P(), false);
20	                _w.WriteLine("START");
21	            }
22	            else if (_on)
23	            {
24	                _on = false;
25	                if (_w != null) { _w.WriteLine("END"); _w.Flush(); _w.Close(); _w = null; }
26	            }
27	        }
28	        static void H(char tag)
29	        {
30	            if (!_on) return;
31	            var r = Terraria.WorldGen.genRand;
32	            if (_sa == null)
33	            {
34	                var t = r.GetType();
35	                _sa = t.GetField("SeedArray", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
36	                _ix = t.GetField("inext", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);
37	            }
38	            var sa = (int[])_sa.GetValue(r);
39	            uint ix = (uint)_ix.GetValue(r);
40	            uint h = 2166136261u;

42	            {
43	                int v = sa[k];
44	                h = (h ^ (uint)(v & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
45	                h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 8) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
46	                h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 16) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
47	                h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 24) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
48	            }

50	            h = (h ^ (uint)((ix >> 8) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
51	            h = (h ^ (uint)((ix >> 16) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
52	            h = (h ^ (uint)((ix >> 24) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;
53	            _w.WriteLine(tag == 'a' ? "a " + h.ToString("x8") : "b " + h.ToString("x8"));
54	        }
55	        public static void NA() { H('a'); }   // Next(int) 头
56	        public static void NB() { H('b'); }   // Next(int,int) 头

58	        {
59	            if (!_on) return;

61	            _w.WriteLine($"kill {i} {j} {(t.active() ? t.type.ToString() : "-")}");
62	        }

64	        {
65	            if (!_on) return;

67	        }

  for (let i = 0; i < st.w; i++) {

  let num4 = 0;

    for (let l = y0; l < y0 + 2; l++) {
      if (!st.inBounds(k, l)) { bad = true; break; }

  ctx.destroyObject = true;
  for (let k = x0; k < x0 + 2; k++) {

  }
  ctx.destroyObject = false;
}

function placeTilePreambleClear(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): void {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  if (st.flags[i]) return;                // active 目标不走 Clear（cs:59497 !tile.active()）
  st.type[i] = 0;

  st.half[i] = 0;

  st.paint[i] = 0;

96	 *  近似为 platform(与 HalfBrickPass 同口径) */
97	function solidTile(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {

147	export function runTileCleanupPass(st: TileStore, rng: RNG, _gs: GenState): void {
148	  // ★① pass 头 tileSolid 翻转（cs:21331 `Main.tileSolid[379] = false`）：泡泡块非实心

151	  flipGenSolid([379], false);
152	  const { w, h } = st;
153	
154	  // ② 全图清坡(cs:21333-21343,全图含边缘,先于内层 40 收缩圈)
155	  for (let i = 0; i < w; i++) {
156	    for (let j = 0; j < h; j++) {
157	      const t = st.idx(i, j);
158	      if (!st.flags[t] || !isSaveSlope(st.type[t])) {

161	      }
162	    }
163	  }
164	
165	  for (let k = 40; k < w - 40; k++) {
166	    for (let l = 40; l < h - 40; l++) {
167	      const i = st.idx(k, l);
168	
169	      // ③ 坡接半砖修复(cs:21344-21353):topSlope(1/2) 且左坡(2/4)接右邻半砖、
170	      //    或右坡(1/3)接左邻半砖 → slope=0 + halfBrick=true
171	      if (st.flags[i] && (st.slope[i] === 1 || st.slope[i] === 2)) {
172	        const s: number = st.slope[i]; // 显式 number:后续 3/4 比较是全坡面表(外层门只到 1/2)
173	        const leftSlope = s === 2 || s === 4;
174	        const rightSlope = s === 1 || s === 3;
175	        const r = st.idx(k + 1, l);
176	        const lf = st.idx(k - 1, l);
177	        if ((leftSlope && st.flags[r] && st.half[r] === 1) || (rightSlope && st.flags[lf] && st.half[lf] === 1)) {
178	          st.slope[i] = 0;
179	          st.half[i] = 1;
180	        }
181	      }
182	
183	      // ④ 液体中的 SlowlyDiesInWater 方块清除(cs:21354-21357)
184	      if (st.flags[i] && st.liquid[i] > 0 && SLOWLY_DIES_IN_WATER.has(st.type[i])) {

186	      }
187	
188	      // ⑤ 滴水石笋(cs:21358-21435):空格+无液+上方实心才进
189	      if (!st.flags[i] && st.liquid[i] === 0 && rng.int(0, 2) !== 0 && solidTile(st, k, l - 1)) {
190	        // 上扫(cs:21360-21411):l-2 起向上 num(15-20) 格,液体>=128
191	        let num = rng.int(15, 20); // Next(15,21)
192	        for (let n2 = l - 2; n2 >= l - num; n2--) {
193	          const up = st.idx(k, n2);
194	          if (st.liquid[up] >= 128 && st.liquidType[up] !== LIQUID_TYPE.SHIMMER) {
195	            const maxValue = l - n2; // 距离,最小 2
196	            if (rng.int(0, maxValue - 1) <= 1) { // Next(maxValue)
197	              let drip = dripFor(st.liquidType[up]);
198	              if (st.wall[i] === BEE_WALL) drip = DRIP_HONEY; // cs:21404
199	              st.setTileSilent(k, l, drip, 0, 0);
200	              break;
201	            }
202	          }
203	        }
204	        // 下扫(cs:21413-21429):l+1 起向下 num(3-10) 格,液体>=200
205	        if (!st.flags[i]) {
206	          num = rng.int(3, 10); // Next(3,11)
207	          for (let m = l + 1; m <= l + num; m++) {
208	            const dn = st.idx(k, m);
209	            if (st.liquid[dn] >= 200 && st.liquidType[dn] !== LIQUID_TYPE.SHIMMER) {
210	              const dist = m - l;
211	              if (rng.int(0, dist * 3 - 1) <= 1) { // Next(dist*3)
212	                st.setTileSilent(k, l, dripFor(st.liquidType[dn]), 0, 0);
213	                break;
214	              }
215	            }
216	          }
217	        }
218	        // 小沙堆(cs:21431-21441):上方是沙岩/硬沙 → 1/4 概率放 461
219	        if (!st.flags[i] && rng.int(0, 3) === 0) { // Next(4)
220	          const above = st.idx(k, l - 1);
221	          if (CONV_SANDSTONE.has(st.type[above]) || CONV_HARDENED_SAND.has(st.type[above])) {
222	            st.setTileSilent(k, l, SAND_PILE, 0, 0);
223	          }
224	        }
225	      }
226	
227	      // ⑥ 墙 13/14 液体清零(cs:21437-21439)
228	      if (st.wall[i] === 13 || st.wall[i] === 14) {
229	        st.liquid[i] = 0; // 原版只清液量,liquidType 位保留
230	      }
231	      // ⑥ 墙 87(cs:21441-21458):extraLiquid 特殊种子分支未实装(SeedFlags 无该旗标),
232	      //    恒走普通世界分支 = 液体清零
233	      if (st.wall[i] === 87) {
234	        st.liquid[i] = 0;
235	      }
236	
237	      // ⑦ 137/162 击杀族（cs:21461-21478——★IIII 批补：非纯帧,含 activity 写）
238	      //    137（雕像,frameY/18 ≤2 或 ==5 时其朝向邻格半砖/坡 → 邻格失活）
239	      //    162（薄冰,下方无液体且 CanKillTile → 失活——T0>162×387 根因）
240	      if (st.flags[i] && st.type[i] === sheetId(137)) {
241	        const fy = Math.floor(st.frameY[i]! / 18);
242	        if (fy <= 2 || fy === 5) {
243	          const dir = st.frameX[i]! >= 18 ? 1 : -1;

247	          }

252	      // ⑦ 31/12/639/箱/28/祭坛帧规范化（cs:21484-21741）——纯帧/自放置端已保证,

/** 按内部 tile id 查生成期实心值（Main.tileSolid[type] 等价）。 */
export function genSolidType(t: number): boolean {
  const o = solidOverrides.get(t);
  if (o !== undefined) return o;
  return !!TILE_DEFS[t]?.solid;
}

/** 原版 Main.tileSolid=true 而 TILE_DEFS.solid(运行时碰撞)=false 的 9 类 sheet：
 *  19 平台族(Main.cs:7842)/239/380/427/435-439(Echo 族)——vanilla-tilecollision.json
 *  对账差集（这 9 类无生成期翻转记录）。genSolidType() 兜底是 TILE_DEFS.solid
 *  （碰撞语义），凡语义上要读「生成期 Main.tileSolid」的调用方（Pots 首实心门/
 *  PlacePot 地面门、SpreadGrass 3×3 实心扫描等）须经由本包装——尾部清剿批
 *  2026-08-17。 */
const VAN_TILE_SOLID_EXTRA = new Set([19, 239, 380, 427, 435, 436, 437, 438, 439]);
const SHEET_OF_TYPE = new Int32Array(TILE_DEFS.length).fill(-1);
for (let i = 0; i < TILE_DEFS.length; i++) {
  const s = TILE_DEFS[i]?.vanilla?.sheet;
  if (typeof s === 'number') SHEET_OF_TYPE[i] = s;
}
export function vanGenSolidType(t: number): boolean {
  if (VAN_TILE_SOLID_EXTRA.has(SHEET_OF_TYPE[t] ?? -1)) return true;
  return genSolidType(t);
}

/** 生成期实心查询（供消费端替代裸 `TILE_DEFS[t]?.solid`）：
 *  active && 生成期 tileSolid。half/slope/platform 等衍生语义由调用方自行叠加
 *  （各 pass 的 SolidTile 近似口径不一,不在此处收敛）。 */
export function isGenSolid(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): boolean {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return false;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  if (!st.flags[i]) return false;
  return genSolidType(st.type[i]);
}

export class UnifiedRandom {
  private seedArray: Int32Array;
  private inext = 0;

  constructor(seed: number) {
    this.seedArray = new Int32Array(56);
    this.setSeed(seed);
  }

  /** C# SetSeed（UnifiedRandom.cs:25-61）1:1 */
  setSeed(seed: number): void {
    this.seedArray.fill(0);
    // C#: (Seed == int.MinValue) ? int.MaxValue : Math.Abs(Seed)
    const num = seed === -2147483648 ? 2147483647 : Math.abs(seed);
    let num2 = 161803398 - num;
    this.seedArray[55] = num2;
    let num3 = 1;
    for (let j = 1; j < 55; j++) {
      const num4 = (21 * j) % 55;
      this.seedArray[num4] = num3;
      num3 = (num2 - num3) | 0; // C# unchecked int：可能回绕，|0 = ToInt32 同语义
      if (num3 < 0) num3 += 2147483647; // C# += int.MaxValue（不是 2^32！）
      num2 = this.seedArray[num4];
    }
    for (let k = 1; k < 5; k++) {
      for (let l = 1; l < 56; l++) {
        this.seedArray[l] -= this.seedArray[1 + ((l + 30) % 55)];
        if (this.seedArray[l] < 0) this.seedArray[l] += 2147483647;
      }
    }
    this.inext = 0;
  }

  /** C# Sample（:63-65）*/
  private sample(): number {
    return this.internalSample() * 4.656612875245797e-10;
  }

  /** C# InternalSample（:67-86）1:1。inext 为 uint 语义（0..55，无溢出面）*/
  private internalSample(): number {
    let num = this.inext + 1;
    if (num > 55) num = 1;
    let num2 = num + 21;
    if (num2 > 55) num2 -= 55;
    let num3 = this.seedArray[num] - this.seedArray[num2];
    if (num3 === 2147483647) num3--;
    num3 = num3 + ((num3 >> 31) & 0x7fffffff); // >>31 算术移位，JS/C# 一致
    this.seedArray[num] = num3;
    this.inext = num;
    return num3;
  }

  /** C# GetSampleForLargeRange（:96-104）。注意两次 InternalSample 的求值顺序 */
  private getSampleForLargeRange(): number {
    let num = this.internalSample();
    if (this.internalSample() % 2 === 0) num = -num;
    return (num + 2147483646) / 4294967293;
  }

  /** C# Next()（:106-108）：裸 int32 */
  next(): number {
    return this.internalSample();
  }

  /** C# Next(minValue, maxValue)（:115-133）：[min, max)。maxValue 负值时 C# 抛异常，
   *  本移植不抛（生成期契约保证入参合法）。*/
  nextIntRange(minValue: number, maxValue: number): number {
    const num = maxValue - minValue; // C# long 减法，≤2^32，JS 精确
    if (num <= 2147483647) {
      return (Math.trunc(this.sample() * num) + minValue) | 0;
    }
    return (Math.trunc(this.getSampleForLargeRange() * num) + minValue) | 0;
  }

  /** C# Next(maxValue)（:121-127）：[0, max) */
  nextInt(maxValue: number): number {
    return Math.trunc(this.sample() * maxValue);
  }

  /** C# NextDouble()（:113-115）*/
  nextDouble(): number {
    return this.sample();
  }

  /** C# Peek()（:88-99，非消耗）：下一 InternalSample 原始差值——对账/断点用 */
  peek(): number {
    let num = this.inext + 1;
    if (num > 55) num = 1;
    let num2 = num + 21;
    if (num2 > 55) num2 -= 55;
    return this.seedArray[num] - this.seedArray[num2];
  }
}

// ── RNG：世界生成/运行时统一入口（API 不变，内核换 UnifiedRandom）──────────
// 与原版调用点的对账约定（gen 代码全部按此书写）：
//   rng.next()   = NextDouble()          每次消耗 1 个 InternalSample

\"/tmp/ssss-draws.txt\" : p; }\n        public static void RP(string passName)\n        {\n            bool target = passName == \"Piles\" || passName == \"Tile Cleanup\";\n            if (target)\n            {\n                _on = true;\n                _w = new StreamWriter(P(), true);\n                _w.WriteLine(\"PASS \" + passName);\n                _gpaCount = 0;\n            }\n            else if (_on)\n            {\n                _on = false;\n                if (_w != null) { _w.WriteLine(\"END gpa=\" + _gpaCount); _w.Flush(); _w.Close(); _w = null; }\n            }\n        }\n        static void H(char tag)\n        {\n            if (!_on) return;\n            var r = Terraria.WorldGen.genRand;\n            if (_sa == null)\n            {\n                var t = r.GetType();\n                _sa = t.GetField(\"SeedArray\", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);\n                _ix = t.GetField(\"inext\", BindingFlags.NonPublic | BindingFlags.Instance);\n            }\n            var sa = (int[])_sa.GetValue(r);\n            uint ix = (uint)_ix.GetValue(r);\n            uint h = 2166136261u;\n            for (int k = 0; k < sa.Length; k++)\n            {\n                int v = sa[k];\n                h = (h ^ (uint)(v & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;\n                h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 8) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;\n                h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 16) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;\n                h = (h ^ (uint)((v >> 24) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;\n            }\n            h = (h ^ (ix & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;\n            h = (h ^ (uint)((ix >> 8) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;\n            h = (h ^ (uint)((ix >> 16) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;\n            h = (h ^ (uint)((ix >> 24) & 0xFF)) * 16777619u;\n            _w.WriteLine(tag == 'a' ? \"a \" + h.ToString(\"x8\") : \"b \" + h.ToString(\"x8\"));\n        }\n        public static void NA() { H('a'); }   // Next(int) 头\n        public static void NB() { H('b'); }   // Next(int,int) 头\n        public static void KT(int i, int j)\n        {\n            if (!_on) return;\n            var t = Terraria.Main.tile[i, j];\n            _w.WriteLine($\"kill {i} {j} {(t.active() ? t.type.ToString() : \"-\")}\");\n        }\n        public static void PL(int x, int y, int type, int style)\n        {\n            if (!_on) return;\n            _w.WriteLine($\"P3 {x} {y} {type} {style}\");\n        }\n        // #77 仲裁：PlaceSmallPile(i,j,...) 命中两格时 dump 5x5 + SolidTile2 判定\n        static bool Cell(int i, int j) { return (i == 3384 && j == 854) || (i == 212 && j == 922); }\n        public static void PS(int i, int j, int pileStyle, int pileSize, int type)\n        {\n            if (!_on) return;\n            _w.WriteLine($\"PS {i} {j} {type} {pileStyle}\");\n            if (!Cell(i, j)) return;\n            _w.WriteLine($\"## ARB ({i},{j}) style={pileStyle} size={pileSize} type={type}\");\n            for (int dy = -2; dy <= 2; dy++)\n            {\n                var parts = new System.Text.StringBuilder();\n                for (int dx = -2; dx <= 2; dx++)\n                {\n                    var t = Terraria.Main.tile[i + dx, j + dy];\n                    parts.Append($\"({i + dx},{j + dy}) {(t.active() ? \"t\" + t.type : \"t_\")} s{t.slope()} h{(t.halfBrick() ? 1 : 0)} l{t.liquid} lt{t.liquidAmount()} \");\n                }\n                _w.WriteLine(\"ARB \" + parts.ToString());\n            }\n            for (int yy = j - 1; yy <= j + 2; yy++)\n                _w.WriteLine($\"ARB ST2({i},{yy})={Terraria.WorldGen.SolidTile2(i, yy)} ST3({i},{yy})={Terraria.WorldGen.SolidTile3(i, yy)} ST({i},{yy})={Terraria.WorldGen.SolidTile(i, yy)}\");\n            _w.WriteLine($\"ARB ST2({i - 1},{j + 1})={Terraria.WorldGen.SolidTile2(i - 1, j + 1)} ST2({i + 1},{j + 1})={Terraria.WorldGen.SolidTile2(i + 1, j + 1)}\");\n        }\n        // Piles ⑤ 段迭代计数（GetPileGenerationAttempts 每 ⑤/①/②/④ 迭代恰好 1 次）\n        public static void GPA()\n        {\n            if (!_on) return;\n            _gpaCount++;\n            _w.WriteLine(\"gpa \" + _gpaCount);\n        }\n    }\n}\n"
}

# MonoKickstart Shell Script
# Written by Ethan "flibitijibibo" Lee

	else
		./TerrariaServer.bin.osx $@
	fi
fi

function getDesiredStalagtiteStyle(
  st: TileStore, x: number, j: number,
): { fail: boolean; style: number; height: number; y: number } {
  const i0 = st.idx(x, j);
  const fy = st.frameY[i0]!;
  let num = 0, y = j, height = 1;
  let supSheet: number;
  if (fy === 72) {
    num = 0;
    supSheet = sheetActive(st, x, j - 1);
  } else if (fy === 90) {
    num = 1;
    supSheet = sheetActive(st, x, j + 1);
  } else if (fy >= 36) {
    if (fy === 54) y--;
    height = 2;
    num = 4;
    supSheet = sheetActive(st, x, y + 2);
  } else {
    if (fy === 18) y--;
    height = 2;
    num = 3;
    supSheet = sheetActive(st, x, y - 1);
  }
  if (supSheet === 1 || MOSS_SHEETS.has(supSheet)) {
    return { fail: false, style: num === 3 && st.wall[i0] === 62 ? 11 : 0, height, y };
  }
  switch (supSheet) {
    case 200: return { fail: false, style: 10, height, y };
    case 164: return { fail: false, style: 8, height, y };
    case 163: return { fail: false, style: 9, height, y };
    case 117: case 402: case 403: return { fail: false, style: 1, height, y };
    case 25: case 398: case 400: return { fail: false, style: 2, height, y };
    case 203: case 399: case 401: return { fail: false, style: 3, height, y };
    case 396: case 397: return { fail: false, style: 4, height, y };
    case 367: return { fail: false, style: 6, height, y };
    case 368: return { fail: false, style: 5, height, y };
    case 147: case 161: return { fail: false, style: 7, height, y };
  }
  if ((num === 0 || num === 1) && supSheet === 225) return { fail: false, style: 12, height, y };
  return { fail: true, style: 0, height, y };
}

function sheetActive(st: TileStore, x: number, y: number): number {
  if (!st.inBounds(x, y)) return -1;
  const i = st.idx(x, y);
  return st.flags[i] ? (TILE_DEFS[st.type[i]]?.vanilla?.sheet ?? -1) : -1;
}

/** 生成开始清零（对应原版 Main.tileSolid 为进程级静态、每局生成重放同一翻转
 *  时间线；清零保证多次 generateWorld 不携带上一局的残留覆写）。 */
export function resetGenSolid(): void {
  solidOverrides.clear();
}

/** 翻转入口：sheetIds 为**原版 sheet id**（Main.tileSolid 下标），内部 id 经
 *  IDS_BY_SHEET 反查——消费端查 st.type 得内部 id,勿把 sheet id 当内部 id 用
 *  （本仓 liquidType 等编码陷阱同源）。solid=false→记非实心/true→记实心。 */
export function flipGenSolid(sheetIds: number[], solid: boolean): void {
  for (const sh of sheetIds) {
    const ids = IDS_BY_SHEET.get(sh);
    if (!ids) continue;
    for (const id of ids) solidOverrides.set(id, solid);
  }
}

/** 生成期覆写表快照/回放（隔离重放对拍用：管线时点状态原样搬运,不重演翻转序）。 */
export function snapshotGenSolid(): Map<number, boolean> {
  return new Map(solidOverrides);
}
export function restoreGenSolid(snap: Map<number, boolean>): void {
  solidOverrides.clear();
  for (const [k, v] of snap) solidOverrides.set(k, v);

```
